entries.english: At Püssensheim, a village in the Amt Prosselsheim, Gotfried von Limpurg, Bischof, pledged the tithe there to Anselm von Rosenberg, Ritter, for five years on the Friday after Quasimodo Sunday in 1445. Contractuum Limpurg, fol. 27.

facts.content: received the tithe at Püssensheim from Gotfried von Limpurg for five years.
